name: Creones
text: Creones is a variant spelling of Cerones, a people of ancient Scotland. MacKillop points the reader to the Picts entry for the wider picture. The form belongs to the class of tribal names Roman writers recorded in northern Britain. The spelling shows how scribes moved between letters across the old sources. Students of the Pictish kingdoms treat the two names as one people.

okr.objective: Place the Creones among the named peoples of ancient northern Britain.
key_results: MacKillop records Creones as a variant spelling of Cerones.
The entry directs readers to the Picts material.
